scientific_integrity: The factor-complexity formula and prior palindrome-avoidance theorem are credited; equivalent results in unindexed sources are possible. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for base >=3 and modulus >=3, uses ordinary reversal, and imports the known all-length factor-complexity function. Finite computation corroborates an independently stated infinite proof.
title: Base-uniform reflection rigidity and a gcd law for digit-sum words
